title: Call it What it is-- Murder
summary: We need to call it murder. You take donations from the NRA you profit from murder. You submit NRA membership dues you pay for murder. We need to make this a battle cry from now until November and encourage our responsible gun owning neighbors to reject the NRA and their complicity in murder.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
We need to call it murder.

You take donations from the NRA you profit from murder.

You submit NRA membership dues you pay for murder.

We need to make this a battle cry from now until November and encourage our responsible gun owning neighbors to reject the NRA and their complicity in murder.
